title: pest-plugin-code-quality baseline
description: Written by --quality-baseline-generate and --quality-baseline-tighten, read on every run a baseline is configured for.

entries.description: One accepted excess per symbol, sorted by policy then symbol. Only values above the configured limit are stored.

policy.description: The policy's stable identity: its test description, or its target list, plus the metric.

symbol.description: Fully qualified Class::method for a method-scoped metric, and fully qualified Class for a class-scoped one.

limit.description: The limit configured when the entry was written. An entry whose policy now configures a different limit is stale.

accepted.description: The measured value accepted for this symbol. Always greater than limit.

path.description: Diagnostic only; never part of any identity.
